newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Radio Centro estimate up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Radio Centro estimate up.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns said Thursday it had raised its 1996 earnings estimate for Grupo Radio Centro SA to $0.20 per ADR from $0.14.

-- "We are leaving our 1997 estimate at $0.26 for now, unchanged until we get a better sense of how 1997 broadcast revenues begin to build up through the first quarter," analysts Carlos Laboy and Hector Tassinari said in a report.
-- "Notwithstanding, management guidance and our own macro outlook leads us to believe that our 1997 estimate is conservative," it added.
